title: Support the core workflow offline
description: After one successful installation, make startup, project access, content editing, sheet preview, uncalibrated PDF preparation, and workspace export work with the network blocked using bundled application assets and fonts.
acceptanceCriteria: A previously installed production build starts with the network blocked
Opening projects, editing content, previewing sheets, preparing uncalibrated PDFs, and exporting backups complete offline
Core workflows make no external asset, image, font, API, telemetry, or service request
Offline status is persistent, semantic, keyboard accessible, and does not imply cloud recovery
IndexedDB remains authoritative and user data is not stored as a service-worker cache substitute

steps.details: Trace production startup and the named flow to identify application chunks, workers, fonts, icons, and other resources required after installation.
Precache or safely runtime-cache only versioned application assets needed by the core flow while excluding user records and generated artifacts.
Remove external runtime font/asset dependencies from core paths and ensure durable content references local IndexedDB assets.
Present understandable offline status and limitations without blocking local actions or promising server recovery.
Install the production build, block network, reload, exercise the named flow, and assert no unexpected network dependency or user-data cache entry.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use one small project and a focused installed-build offline smoke.
Offline support begins after successful initial installation and does not promise every browser/platform combination.
